about: Every floor with rows that the overnight sweep of every airport's live board recorded (2026-10-19, 1920x1080, build v24064; the later rechecks A and B and the reruns too): the view it was drawn in, its size, the moment and the board's languages; the page's places as this build reads them, in the order of the page's rows (code, lat, lon, zone, name, every language's name, flights, flown, next; the next flight is the one whose name the live board drew larger, or, on a full map that drew no name larger (its next flight past the room on the page, or in a list), the one place the same board's strip named in the same second, just before the map was recorded; a place is flown when every flight to it that is not cancelled had gone). A row with no code that the map now reads stands where the row stood on the page, as the floor's full-board screenshot shows it. Positions, zones and names are this build's (v24070). Also what main (v24067, #1062) named on main's own page, measured with the board's font; which of those names were in a conflict there (by another place's dot or arrow, nearer another place's mark than its own however little, another place's route under the name, a line through a name, two names touching); and each route of another place that ran under one of main's names (main.under, [name, route]: through the name, or cut away under it by main's one mask for every route). The font: the board's, as the floor measures it. tests/earth-floor-sweep.test.js

font.about: Bricolage Grotesque (fids-current/fonts/bricolage, the board's font) at weight 700, width 100, optical size = the pixel size, as the floor draws its names: each character's advance and each pair's kerning in units of 1/1000 em, read from the repo's woff2 subsets with fontTools; the floor's textW adds 0.01 em a letter and 0.2 em. Chrome's canvas measureText agrees within 0.15 px.
